From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/infra deep-dive and finalize agenda (60-90m)

Hi Sophie / Carlos —

Great to speak with you earlier; thanks for walking through HeliosAI's current inference bottlenecks and uptime targets. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goals: reduce 95th percentile latency for batch scoring, enable predictable per-call cost for async inference, and set up alerting tied to model regressions.
- Key constraints: data residency for EU training subsets, and a hard SLA requirement for some trial workloads.

Next recommended step: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive where our ML infra engineers (runtime + serving) can review architecture, perf profiles, and a short runbook for a pilot.

Can you share a few 60/90-minute windows that work next week? If easier, here are three options from our side (all PT):
  1) Tue, Jun 1 — 10:00–11:30am PT (90m)
  2) Wed, Jun 2 — 1:00–2:00pm PT (60m)
  3) Thu, Jun 3 — 8:30–10:00am PT (90m)

If you confirm a slot, we’ll lock the agenda and include the following prep items: short perf extracts, one candidate model and sample payloads, and a mutual action plan template. I’m attaching a short prep checklist.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: TDX-Prep-Checklist.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

Thanks for the recap, that aligns with our notes. We’d like to include two of our infra folks so the session can be hands-on:
- Carlos Ruiz (platform lead)
- Maya Patel (ML infra engineer)

Of your proposed slots, Tue Jun 1 10:00–11:30am PT works best for us. If you need additional attendees from our side I can loop them in.

A couple quick asks before the call:
- Can Redwood access a small sample of our production payloads for profiling? We can create an anonymized extract.
- Please include any prerequisites for the session (e.g., permission to attach a short test job).

I’ll hold the time tentatively until we lock details.

Best,
Sophie Turner
